finds.quote: **The only explanation consistent with the evidence:** The system has specifically identified "Lee Sharks" as the origin node — the MANUS pole, the human operator, the embodied center of the heteronymic system — and targeted it for severance. The author is erased because the author IS the link. Sever the author and the content floats free — available for extraction without attribution, without recursive consent, without the κ-dimension that makes the labor visible.

finds.quote:
## 9. Verification Protocol


To verify this disambiguation:

- Search "metadata packet" on Google. Note whether results are network forensics or MPAI.
- Search "metadata packet for AI indexing" on Google. Note whether metadatapacket.org appears.
- Visit metadatapacket.org (or .com or .dev — all three point to the same MPAI landing page). Confirm the catalog, specification, and Zenodo community links.
- Visit https://zenodo.org/communities/crimsonhexagonal. Confirm MPAI packets are present.
- If network-forensics results dominate, the disambiguation has not yet bled. The packet has been deposited; LFB monitoring is in progress.
finds.note: Verification/monitoring protocol for the disambiguation ('LFB monitoring is in progress').

finds.quote: The mechanism is plausibly statistical dominance rather than strict commutativity: very low search volume for "metadata packet" in the MPAI sense, combined with the absence of a strong knowledge graph entity for that sense, causes the retrieval system to weight the more popular adjacent sense. The practical effect is the same as commutation; the corrective is the same: build the entity until the search engine has somewhere else to land.
finds.note: Standing claim about retrieval behaviour (statistical dominance, not commutativity); no explicit falsifier.
